name: bag_of_holding_returned_while_its_trigger_waits_keeps_out_that_card
notes: The CR 400.7 audit of 2026-11-17 (KNOWLEDGE 212 §3). Bag of Holding loots Spare A away; with its discard trigger ('exile that card from your graveyard') waiting, the Bag is destroyed (the move stands in for the removal) and Brought Back returns it, tapped: a new object (CR 400.7). The waiting trigger is the old object's (CR 113.7a): it exiles Spare A, and the cards it exiles are linked to the old object's abilities only (CR 607.2a). So two turns later the new Bag's sacrifice returns nothing, and Spare A stays in exile. Hand: 2, +1 the loot's draw, -1 Spare A, -1 Brought Back, +1 the turn's draw = 2. Failed on c80f45f7 (the exile was placed in the life it arrived in, after the return, and the new Bag returned Spare A: hand 3): stronger than printed, a card back.
